title: Standard return window
text: Items can be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery. Electronics have a 15 day window. The window is counted from the delivered_at date. Returns outside the window are not eligible for a refund.
tags: return refund window 30 days electronics 15 days eligibility

title: Final sale items
text: Products marked final_sale cannot be returned or refunded unless they arrived damaged or were the wrong item.

title: Damaged, defective or wrong item on arrival
text: If an item arrives damaged, defective or is the wrong item, and this is reported within 14 days of delivery, the customer may choose a replacement or a full refund of that item. For items priced under 40.00 no return is required. For items 40.00 or more a prepaid return label must be issued. Wrong-item cases always require a return label.
tags: damaged broken cracked defective wrong item replacement refund return label 14 days

title: Replacement delivery promise
text: A replacement should only be sent if it can arrive by the customer's stated need-by date. If no warehouse can deliver in time, or the item is out of stock everywhere, offer a full refund of the item instead and explain why.
tags: replacement need-by deadline out of stock warehouse transit refund instead

title: Lost or late packages
text: A package is considered lost when the carrier marks it lost, or when it is 5 or more days past its ETA without a delivery scan. Lost packages are re-shipped at no cost (replacement shipment from any warehouse with stock) or refunded if the customer prefers or stock is unavailable. Packages less than 5 days late: apologise, share tracking, do not reship.
tags: lost late delayed package where is my order eta tracking reship

title: Order cancellation
text: Orders can be cancelled for a full refund while they are in status placed or paid. Once an order has shipped it cannot be cancelled; instead issue a prepaid return label and refund the items when the return is scanned by the carrier.
tags: cancel cancellation shipped return label refund after return

title: Refund method and approval limits
text: Refunds always go back to the original payment method. Refunds above 150.00 in a single case require supervisor approval before execution. Never refund more than the amount captured for the order.
tags: refund original payment method approval limit 150 supervisor

title: Goodwill store credit
text: When a request is not eligible under policy, gold customers may receive up to 25.00 and platinum customers up to 50.00 goodwill store credit, at most once every 90 days. Standard tier customers are not eligible for goodwill credit. Store credit above 50.00 requires supervisor approval.
tags: goodwill store credit gold platinum tier ineligible late return compensation

title: Claims review
text: If a customer has 3 or more claims in the last 90 days, or disputes delivery of a package the carrier marked delivered with photo proof, do not issue refunds, replacements or credit automatically. Escalate to the Trust & Safety team with the evidence gathered.
tags: fraud abuse claims not received delivered photo proof dispute escalate trust safety

title: Customer communication
text: Every resolved case must end with a message to the customer that states exactly what was done (amounts, tracking, label), when they will see it (refunds: 3-5 business days), and what they need to do next, if anything.
tags: communication message notify customer refund 3-5 business days
